name: peri-fuse-monorepo
description: Standalone lightweight LLM observability server — SQLite-backed, no Next.js, no ClickHouse, no Redis

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @peri-fuse/shared run build && pnpm --filter @peri/gateway run build && pnpm --filter @peri-fuse/langfuse-mcp run build && pnpm --filter @peri-fuse/server run build && pnpm --filter @peri-fuse/web run build && pnpm --filter peri-fuse run build
scripts.dev: concurrently "LITE_SERVER_PORT=23432 pnpm --filter @peri-fuse/server run dev" "pnpm --filter @peri-fuse/web run dev"
scripts.test: pnpm run test:ingestion && pnpm --filter @peri/gateway run build && pnpm --filter @peri-fuse/langfuse-mcp run build && pnpm -r --no-bail run test
